site_tagline: Private local AI that gets better the more people use it.
description: Tessera is calibrated and audited quantization for llama.cpp, with ANE prefill on Apple Silicon and first-class speculative decoding. Tessera Studio runs Gemma 4 12B on your Mac for text, vision, audio, and speech. Your data never leaves the device. As more people use Tessera, the model gets smarter, the drafters get more accurate, and the engine gets faster. The recipe and the signed receipt are public; the data method is private. The improved model ships to every Tessera user.

home_hero.headline: Private local AI that gets better the more people use it.
home_hero.subhead: Tessera Studio runs Gemma 4 12B on your Mac. Text, vision, audio, and speech. Your data never leaves the device. As more people use Tessera, the model reasons better on harder problems, the drafters get more accurate, the engine gets faster, and next-token prediction sharpens. The recipe and the signed receipt are public; the data method is private. The improved model ships to every Tessera user, not just whoever paid for it.

what_you_get.title: Local, private, on your Mac.
what_you_get.body: Text, vision, audio, and speech. Your data stays on your device. No cloud, no telemetry that can identify you, no model that phones home.

what_you_get.title: It gets better the more people use it.
what_you_get.body: Better reasoning on harder problems, sharper hybrid drafters, faster engine, SOTA-class next-token prediction. The flywheel runs on a sanitized baseline during idle time.

what_you_get.title: A model you can trust is improving.
what_you_get.body: The recipe is public. The signed receipt is on every release. The sanitization method is private; the audit trail is not.

what_you_get.title: Free, with a clear path for commercial use.
what_you_get.body: Source-available engine. CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 trained models. Commercial licensing is a conversation, not a paywall.

primary.label: Privacy-conscious individuals
primary.description: You don't want cloud AI. You want local, on your machine, on your data. Tessera Studio is the on-ramp.

adjacent.label: Apple Silicon power users
adjacent.description: You want the ANE prefill, the IOSurface hand-off, the on-device throughput. Tessera dispatches across CPU, GPU, and ANE dynamically.

adjacent.label: Inference engineers
adjacent.description: You run llama.cpp and want calibrated quantization with receipts. Tessera is a fork of llama.cpp that adds the kernel-fidelity loop.

peripheral.label: Quant researchers
peripheral.description: You want the evolutionary AWQ, the per-tensor GA, the regime-routed archive. That's on the architecture page.

audiences.not_for: If you don't care about local inference, this isn't for you. If you need bit-for-bit drop-in compatibility with stock llama.cpp for Tessera-quantized artifacts, this isn't for you (vanilla quants work anywhere; Tessera-locked artifacts need the Tessera runtime).

three_tiers.lede: Three tiers. One of which you'll almost certainly be in.

rows.license: Source-available engine, free for non-commercial use
rows.contents: Tessera engine, Tessera Studio, recipes, vanilla quants of upstream models, documentation, concepts. The Tessera Research and Education License 1.0 (PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0) applies to the engine code.
rows.audience: Researchers, hobbyists, contributors, anyone who evaluates locally

rows.contents: Models trained on the Tessera sanitized dataset. Available for download. Inspectable everywhere; runnable on Tessera. The signed receipt on each artifact proves what data and policy produced it.
rows.audience: Anyone using Tessera Studio; commercial use requires a license

rows.contents: Any of the above, used commercially. The license is a relationship, not a different artifact. The commercial licensee gets the right to redistribute under their own terms.
rows.audience: Business partners, production users, custom development
